JomCall: fallback voice listening test

Blind test. Candidates are lettered A–E; the order differs from the README. Every clip is loudness-matched to −20 LUFS. Latency is not in these clips: judge only the sound.

How to rate: for each line pick 1–5 per letter (5 = I would put this on a customer call; 3 = understandable but odd; 1 = wrong words, wrong language, or unpleasant). Listen for: Malay vowels and stress, "RM 85", the time, digits read one by one, the Malay road name, Manglish switching, and silence or clicks at the start. Use the buttons at the bottom to copy your picks and paste them to Claude, or just write "BM: C > A > D" etc. Ratings are kept only in this browser.
